title: A weekend in the country
text:
Dear Ania,

This weekend I am at my uncle's farm in the country. It is very quiet here – no cars, no buses! My uncle has got ten cows, two horses and a lot of chickens. Every morning I help him. I give food to the animals and I get the eggs. It is hard work, but I like it. The weather is not very good. It is windy and it rains in the afternoon. In the evening we play cards and drink hot milk. On Sunday evening I take the train back to the city.

Love,
Julia
